findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fiscalbase_docs, ec_get_document, ec_preview_document, ec_report · Private data: fiscalbase_me, ec_lookup_taxpayer, ec_find, ec_get_document, ec_preview_document, ec_issue_document, ec_document_action, ec_report, ec_suggest_withholding, fiscalbase_api_search · Public sink: ec_lookup_taxpayer, ec_find, ec_preview_document, ec_issue_document, ec_document_action, fiscalbase_api_search, fiscalbase_api_read · Destructive: ec_issue_document, fiscalbase_api_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fiscalbase_docs, ec_get_document, ec_preview_document, ec_report · Private data: fiscalbase_me, ec_lookup_taxpayer, ec_find, ec_get_document, ec_preview_document, ec_issue_document, ec_document_action, ec_report, ec_suggest_withholding, fiscalbase_api_search · Public sink: ec_lookup_taxpayer, ec_find, ec_preview_document, ec_issue_document, ec_document_action, fiscalbase_api_search, fiscalbase_api_read · Destructive: ec_issue_document, fiscalbase_api_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
